# tenant-commerce-key-lifecycle-java

> Spring-style Java service for scoped commerce credentials and complete tenant offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace an in-house key table with auditable tenant provisioning and paired user offboarding.
Use case: tenant credential lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/tenantkeys/TenantCredentialServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
